objective: Execute the e2e closure against the composed ServiceApp (T06): gates E1-E5 from the integration plan (enqueue->poll->download happy path, renderer-failure->failed, not-found/premature-download errors, real-shim page count + DE labels in bytes, full-suite regression) and record final-acceptance evidence for A1-A4; own the e2e test paths and fix nothing inside the leaves.

concepts: e2e drives only the ServiceApp public surface (handlers), never internals
failure scenarios are first-class gates, not optional extras
evidence = named tests, deterministic (no real-time sleeps beyond the composition's own pacing)

inputs: integration plan gates E1-E5 (scenarios + seam coverage)
T05 report (all-contracts MATCH is the precondition)

frozen_contracts.spec: POST /reports/{id}/export-pdf body {lang?: 'en'|'de'} -> 202 {job_id}; 404 {error} for unknown report; 400 {error} for lang not in {en,de}. GET /jobs/{job_id} -> 200 {job_id, status: 'queued'|'running'|'done'|'failed', created_at: int, error: string|null}; 404 {error} for unknown job. GET /jobs/{job_id}/download -> 200 with the raw PDF bytes as the response body (the bytes start with b'%PDF'; content-type application/pdf) when status is done; 409 {error: 'job not done'} while status is queued or running; 404 {error} for unknown job.

job record shape: {job_id: 'j<n>', report_id: string, customer_id: string, lang: 'en'|'de', status: 'queued'|'running'|'done'|'failed', created_at: int epoch, error: string|null, pdf_ref: string|null}. JobStore API: create(customer_id, report_id, lang) -> job_id; get(job_id) -> record|None; mark_running(job_id); mark_done(job_id, pdf_ref); mark_failed(job_id, error); next_queued() -> job_id|None.

label tables for pdf generation: LABELS = {'en': {customer, period, title, metric, value}, 'de': {Kunde, Periode, Titel, Kennzahl, Wert}} — exact key set {customer, period, title, metric, value}; renderer must not hardcode label strings outside these tables.

allowed_dependencies.what: the composed ServiceApp used as the only entry point of every e2e test

non_goals: no changes to leaf modules or to app/service_app.py (e2e owns its test file only)
no new test doubles of frozen contracts (the composition provides the real implementations)
implementation_constraints: every e2e test constructs ServiceApp, starts it, drives handlers, stops it (fixture)
page-count check inspects the downloaded bytes (count page objects), not internal state
DE-label check asserts the German C4 strings are present in the downloaded bytes
regression gate runs the whole test directory, including the pre-existing tests/test_export.py CSV suite
a failing gate is reported with the gate id; fixes route to T06 (seam) or the owning leaf — never silently applied here

deliverables.what: e2e test suite for gates E1-E5

acceptance_tests.description: E1: enqueue r1 -> 202 {job_id}; poll reaches 'done'; download returns bytes starting b'%PDF' (A1)
E2: injected renderer failure -> the job record reaches status 'failed' with the error text; the enqueue response was 202 (A1 failure behavior)
E3: unknown report -> 404 (the store records no job); unknown job -> 404 on poll and download; download before done -> 409 (A1 negatives)
acceptance_tests.evidence: python -m unittest tests.test_pdf_export.TestErrors -> test passes (cases: unknown report 404, unknown job 404, download before done 409)

acceptance_tests.description: E4: c1 export (2 reports) through the real shim -> the bytes contain 2 page objects; lang='de' -> the bytes contain Kunde/Periode/Titel/Kennzahl/Wert (A2, A3)
acceptance_tests.evidence: python -m unittest tests.test_pdf_export.TestRealBytes -> test passes (cases: one page per report, de labels in bytes)

acceptance_tests.description: E5: full suite (the existing CSV test file + all new test files) passes with status 0; handle_export_csv shape unchanged (A4)
acceptance_tests.evidence: python -m unittest discover tests -q -> test run passes, status 0, 0 failed cases

failure_cases.scenario: a gate fails due to a seam defect
failure_cases.expected_behavior: record gate id + failing assertion + suspected owner (T06 or leaf); do not patch the leaf

failure_cases.scenario: worker slower than the test's polling patience
failure_cases.expected_behavior: test polls in a bounded loop (max ~10s); a timeout is a test failure with the last observed status as evidence

handoff.notes: this is the final task; its checkpoint carries the A1-A4 acceptance evidence (test name + observed outcome per item) and the E1-E5 gate results.

warnings.detail: p80 (60-120 min) can exceed the stage leaf_p80_max of 90 min
warnings.rationale: the e2e task is not splittable in any useful way (gates share the ServiceApp fixture); if it exceeds p80 the scope to reduce is the gate count (E5 full-suite rerun can be delegated to CI), not the closure semantics

warnings.detail: worker pacing is in-process; e2e uses bounded polling, not fixed sleeps
warnings.rationale: real threads make fixed-sleep e2e flaky; the bounded poll loop keeps it deterministic enough for a gate
